name: Mosshide Fen
summary: In eastern Wetlands, the Mosshide gnolls keep travelers from their hunting grounds. Their camps lie far from the main trade roads, where danger waits in the marsh.

sections.title: Territory of the Pack
sections.body: Rough lean-tos and bone-strewn camps mark the Mosshide gnolls’ territory in eastern Wetlands. Gnawbone and the other pack leaders command the tribe. Their hunters ambush travelers, scouts, and prospectors who enter the tangled marsh, then devour them.

faq.answer: The Mosshide gnolls claim and settle the sodden marsh of eastern Wetlands.
The Mosshide gnolls occupy the fen under brutal leaders such as Gnawbone. He commands his pack to capture and devour outsiders who trespass on their land.

faq.q: Why is this area dangerous to travelers?
faq.answer: Mosshide gnolls are aggressive and hungry. Travelers who leave established paths or search the wet brush for supplies risk a sudden ambush by hunting packs.

angles.text: As a dwarf, keep watch on Mosshide Fen. Its aggressive gnoll packs threaten prospectors searching the marshes and scouts securing the eastern paths.
